// diagnostic

L0518

Plain `Fixed(n)` output immediately removes grouping separators

What

Plain `Fixed(n)` output immediately removes grouping separators

Why

`Fixed(n)` is machine-plain; deleting this cleanup preserves the same text

Fix

Delete `.replace(",", "")` from the `Fixed(n)` projection

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0518: tests/ui_lint/redundant_fixed_cleanup.warn.

Warning [L0518] (redundant_fixed_cleanup): Plain `Fixed(n)` output immediately removes grouping separators
  --> tests/ui_lint/redundant_fixed_cleanup.jet:3:30
    |
  3 |     print("{value:Fixed(2)}".replace(",", ""))
    |                              ^^^^^^^
 Why: `Fixed(n)` is machine-plain; deleting this cleanup preserves the same text
 Fix: Delete `.replace(",", "")` from the `Fixed(n)` projection
